value: SRMA: Department of Defense (DoD); DoD CIO - CMMC Program Management Office; Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) - NISPOM; State Department DDTC (ITAR); Commerce BIS (EAR)

Direct analogue to the HIPAA Security Rule for the DIB: binding, 110 enumerated requirements with a defined assessment methodology and scoring, third-party certification (C3PAO) becoming a condition of award from Phase 2 (Nov. 10, 2026).

Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) / Covered Defense Information; Controlled Technical Information; Federal Contract Information (FCI); ITAR technical data; EAR-controlled technology; Classified information (NISPOM)

CUI enclaves / GCC-High or FedRAMP Moderate cloud; PLM/CAD and engineering data repositories; MES and CNC/additive manufacturing; ERP (e.g., DCAA-compliant accounting); Classified information systems; Test and evaluation systems
CMMC assessment (32 CFR Part 170) for DoD contracts; SOC 2 is secondary
CMMC phase-in: Phase 1 Nov. 10, 2025; Phase 2 Nov. 10, 2026; Phase 3 Nov. 10, 2027; Phase 4 Nov. 10, 2028. FAR CUI proposed rule (Jan. 15, 2025) not final.
